notes.title: Early Access Build 10 / Hotfix 01
notes.content:
Fixed issue preventing Waspbuddy pickups from spawning in the Thicket biome.
Audited hitboxes for all ships.
Fixed a bug with Melfina-S' tail not distorting background tiles when cloaked.
